title: Section cohomology presheaf of a resolution complex
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $K^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of sheaves of $\mathcal O_T$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], indexed by $\mathbb N$, with $q\in\mathbb N$. Define the section-cohomology presheaf $P=\operatorname{sectionCohomologyPresheaf}(K^\bullet,q)$ on $T_{\mathrm{Zar}}^{\mathrm{op}}$ by $P(V)=H^q(\Gamma(V,K^\bullet))$ for each open $V\subseteq T$, where $\Gamma(V,K^\bullet)$ is obtained by applying sections degreewise and $H^q$ is cycles modulo boundaries. For an inclusion $V\subseteq W$, define the restriction map $P(W)\to P(V)$ as the map on $q$-th cohomology induced degreewise by the section restrictions $\Gamma(W,K^i)\to\Gamma(V,K^i)$. Thus all values and restriction maps of $P$ are fixed, with no flatness or base-change hypotheses.
